extracted.intended_audience: people interested in the MacArthur Fellows program (potential nominees, nominators, fellows, and the general public)
extracted.subtask_description: Guiding criteria and program features used by the MacArthur Fellows Program to identify individuals for unrestricted fellowships, emphasizing originality, creativity, dedication, self-direction, and future potential across many fields.

rubrics_metrics.name: Extraordinary originality / creativity
rubrics_metrics.description: Individuals who have shown extraordinary originality in their creative pursuits (the page also says Fellows were selected for their 'creativity' and 'originality').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Verbatim: 'The MacArthur Fellows Program awards unrestricted fellowships to talented individuals who have shown extraordinary originality ...' and a press release states Fellows were 'selected for their creativity, originality, and potential to make important contributions in the future.'

rubrics_metrics.name: Dedication in creative pursuits
rubrics_metrics.description: Demonstrated dedication to their creative pursuits.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Verbatim: '...who have shown extraordinary originality and dedication in their creative pursuits...' — indicates sustained commitment to the work/field is a selection factor.

rubrics_metrics.name: Marked capacity for self-direction
rubrics_metrics.description: A clear ability to direct one’s own work and career without requiring external direction.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Verbatim: '...and a marked capacity for self-direction.' Implies independence, initiative, and the ability to use fellowship support autonomously.

rubrics_metrics.name: Talent
rubrics_metrics.description: Being a 'talented individual' is an explicit baseline for consideration.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Verbatim: 'awards unrestricted fellowships to talented individuals' — talent (skill, mastery, or notable aptitude) is a fundamental criterion.

rubrics_metrics.name: Potential to make important future contributions
rubrics_metrics.description: Evidence or expectation that the person will make important contributions in the future.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Verbatim from press release: 'selected for their ... potential to make important contributions in the future.' This is a forward-looking assessment of promise/impact.

rubrics_metrics.name: Cross‑disciplinary / broad spectrum of endeavors
rubrics_metrics.description: Selection considers work across a broad spectrum of endeavors rather than being limited to one discipline.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Verbatim from press release: 'Working across a broad spectrum of endeavors, the Fellows were selected...' — indicates openness to many fields and interdisciplinary accomplishments.

rubrics_metrics.name: Unrestricted fellowship (no specified project/use constraints)
rubrics_metrics.description: The award is provided as an unrestricted fellowship rather than tied to a specified project or institutional grant.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Verbatim: 'The MacArthur Fellows Program awards unrestricted fellowships ...' — program feature implying recipients have discretion in using the funds; the page does not list allowable/forbidden uses.
